Grüße, Zoë: 5 €
cases.doc: UTF-8 source literals read as code points. Tarver's S42 SBCL build, shen-cl (file loads) and shen-go read source BYTES and rebuild text with n->string per byte, i.e. they decode source as Latin-1: "ü" becomes the two characters U+00C3 U+00BC and prints as mojibake. shen-lua decodes UTF-8 (issue #80)
